run_diatomic_curve_computation: run a diatomic potential energy curve computation for a given MLIP model and atom pair
generate_diatomic_energy_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of relative energy vs distance for a diatomic molecule
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve using a pretrained MLIP predictor and reference energies
get_model_predictor: get a pretrained MLIP predictor for released or unreleased models on a CUDA device
combined_diatomic_plot: create a combined plot showing multiple diatomic potential energy curves on a single figure
